penalties.description: Contact to the back of the body, including the back of the buttocks and the back of the thighs.
penalties.signal: Start with your arms forward, bent at a 90-degree angle, palms forward. Straighten your elbows and extend your arms forward in a 'push' motion.

penalties.description: Contact to the head or neck, down to the collarbone.
penalties.signal: Hand raised to the side of the head.

penalties.description: Contact to the legs from below mid-thigh to the wheels of the skate.
penalties.signal: Hand pointed downward toward the lower leg.

penalties.description: Initiating a block using the head or neck, or intentionally using the head or neck to positionally block.
penalties.signal: Hand placed on top of the head.

penalties.description: Initiating a block using the forearm, from the point of the elbow to the fingertips.
penalties.signal: One forearm raised horizontally in front of the body.

penalties.description: Initiating a block using the legs from below mid-thigh to the wheels of the skate.
penalties.signal: Hand pointed downward toward the lower leg.

penalties.description: Initiating a block while Down, Out of Bounds, Out of Play, airborne, stopped, or skating clockwise. Also includes illegal assists and early hits before the Jam starts.
penalties.signal: Arms crossed in front of the chest.

penalties.description: Blocking while skating clockwise, or a stop block — actively maintaining a stopped position which impedes an opponent.
penalties.signal: Finger pointed and rotated in a clockwise circle.

penalties.description: Forming an impenetrable wall by linking with or grasping a teammate when an opponent attempts and fails to pass between them.
penalties.signal: Both arms extended and linked at the elbows in front of the body.

penalties.description: Illegally destroying or failing to reform the Pack, intentionally skating Out of Bounds, failing to return to the Engagement Zone, or failing to yield after a false start.
penalties.signal: Both hands placed on top of the head.

penalties.description: Using the Out of Bounds area to gain position on an opponent who is Upright and In Bounds. Also includes illegal re-entry to the track.
penalties.signal: Two fingers pointed downward in a scissors motion.

penalties.description: Any action that interferes with the flow of the game, including causing the period clock to stop illegally, preventing a Jam from starting, or ending a Jam prematurely. Includes delay of game.
penalties.signal: Both arms raised and crossed overhead.

penalties.description: Technical violations of the rules that have significant impact on the game, including Star Pass violations and Star Pass interference.
penalties.signal: Index finger pointed upward and rotated in a small circle.

penalties.description: Unsporting conduct including deceiving or ignoring Officials, disrespectful conduct, abusive language or behavior, or actions that undermine the legitimacy of the sport. Includes insubordination.
penalties.signal: Both hands placed on the hips.
